data.name: Deliver Together
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO THE MOST CHAOTIC, COOPERATIVE, AND DOWNRIGHT HILARIOUS TRUCKING SIMULATOR EVER.

Deliver Together is the ultimate test of coordination, driving skills, and patience. Whether you are going solo or teaming up with friends, the goal is simple: get the cargo to the finish line. You do not just drive a truck, you control a massive rig powered by two separate trucks attached to a looooong trailer. Maneuver through tracks, manage the weight of your cargo, and try not to pull your teammate off the road.

  • SOLO MODE (The Ultimate Brain Teaser): Command both the front AND rear trucks by yourself. Try not to argue with yourself as your left hand and right hand develop a bitter rivalry.

  • 2-PLAYER CO-OP (The Friendship Test): One of you steers the front. The other steers the back. Communication is key. Blaming each other is inevitable. The main way Deliver Together was made to be played.

  • 2-PLAYER PVP: It's a race! Each player commands their own duo of trucks and a trailer racking chaos in the track.

  • 3 PLAYERS (The Odd One In): Two players team up on one trailer, while the third player commands their own two-truck rig.

  • 4-8 PLAYERS: Each team controls 2 trucks connected by a trailer (Up to 4 teams). The track becomes a chaos of honking, crashing, and desperate, last-minute corrections.

  • Truck Race (Free For All): Forget about the trailer, each player controls a semi truck with the goal to reach the finish line first.

Will you be hauling sensible cargo like lumber or electric generators? Sometimes. More often, you'll be hauling more important goods, like some jiggly geese, or like the most important and precious thing "a chair", yes, just a chair on this loooong trailer. Because why should your journey be realistic when it can be fun and memorable?

  • 10 Wild Tracks, From city downtown to mountainous cliffs.

  • Up to 8 Players in custom-built, mega-wide tracks for 4-team trailer battles.

  • Vehicle Cosmetics to show off your truck in multiplayer (To look cool even when falling off a cliff).

  • A Track Editor to build and share your own diabolical courses with other players.

  • Leaderboards to compete and prove you are the best driver out there.

  • Economy, where you will be able to earn in-game currencies from finishing the tracks.

  • Quick Play for instant, random cargo-and-track combo combination.

  • 30 Different Cargo: Discover some of the silly and surreal items you'll be hauling across the valley.

SO GET READY. GRAB A FRIEND (OR SEVEN FRIENDS!). AND TRY TO REACH THE FINISH LINE WITHOUT BREAKING YOUR FRIENDSHIP.

Deliver Together is less about the perfect and realistic trucking simulator and more about the fun you will have when your teammate steered you directly into a river, and that time you won by a millisecond when competing while hauling rubber geese.

Wishlist now, assemble your crew, and get ready for the upcoming full version release of Deliver Together.

Help us by spreading the word out!

data.short_description: In Deliver Together, You control either (or both) of the two trucks attached to the same loooong trailer. And who's driving? Oh, just you. Or you and a friend. Or maybe eight of you, all screaming different directions at once. Your goal is to reach the finish line in chaotic tracks.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-8120
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 4GB, Radeon RX 460 4GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 8 GB, Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
